Bug_Details:
SpotBugs generated a warning that, according to a @NoWarning annotation,
  is unexpected or undesired. @NoWarning
Bug_Explanation: The spotBugs tool may unexpectedly flag a warning due to the creation of a new ArrayList from an existing list without apparent reason, even though this is a valid operation. This is marked with @NoWarning annotation in certain cases to specify that the warning should not be raised.
Trigger_Explanation: The testShowBug method calls the showBug method which returns a new ArrayList, potentially triggering an unexpected SpotBugs warning. The test deliberately fails to highlight the presence of the bug by asserting that the result is null even though it is not.
